subject.title: fix(control-ui): add tooltips for Reasoning and Thinking dropdowns (#90445)

question: Should the Sessions details panel ship provider-neutral Thinking and display-oriented Reasoning tooltips as a standalone partial fix while broader naming, inheritance, Quick Settings, and documentation work remains open?
rationale: The canonical issue carries an explicit product-direction signal, and merging this PR establishes user-facing terminology on one surface before the complete terminology and inheritance story is decided.

options.title: Approve Sessions-only wording
options.body: Accept the narrow neutral tooltips after locale consistency, conflict resolution, and browser proof, while keeping the canonical issue open for the remaining surfaces.

options.title: Wait for unified terminology
options.body: Pause this PR until naming, inheritance semantics, Quick Settings, and documentation can be decided together.

recommendation.title: Approve Sessions-only wording
recommendation.body: Accept the narrow neutral tooltips after locale consistency, conflict resolution, and browser proof, while keeping the canonical issue open for the remaining surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects him to both provider thinking semantics and Control UI documentation, making him the strongest available terminology owner.
